name: Oak Leaf Gall Midge
desc: Oak Leaf Gall Midge (Polystepha pilulae): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Polystepha pilulae, the oak leaf gall midge, is a species of gall midge in the family Cecidomyiidae. It is found in eastern North America.
